mail.link.description: Would you like to add another mail to integrate it into your automation with the help of Dulno? Just click on the logo.
mail.trigger.receive.name: Email Receive
mail.trigger.receive.description: Is triggered when you receive a new email
mail.trigger.receive.input.mail.name: Email
mail.trigger.receive.input.mail.descript: The email whose mailbox is to be checked for new emails
mail.trigger.receive.output.title: Email title
mail.action.send.name: Send email
mail.action.send.description: Sends an email you have compiled to a recipient
mail.action.send.input.mail.name: Email
mail.action.send.input.mail.description: The email from which the message is to be sent
mail.action.send.input.prefix.name: Prefix
mail.action.send.input.prefix.descriptio: The prefix that is displayed to the recipient before the domain. The recipient then sees the sender as prefix@domain.com, for example
mail.action.send.input.name.name: Name
mail.action.send.input.name.description: The name that is displayed to the recipient as the sender
mail.action.send.input.receiver.name: Receiver
mail.action.send.input.receiver.descript: The email address of the recipient
mail.action.send.input.title.name: Email title
mail.action.send.input.title.description: The title of the email that is displayed to the recipient
mail.action.send.input.body.name: Email body
mail.action.send.input.body.description: The content of the email you want to send to the recipient
mail.action.send.output.title: Email title
mail.action.send.failure.mail.not.found: An error has occurred while sending an email. The error occurred because the mail account could not be found. Could it be that you have removed the email?
mail.action.send.failure.mail.exception: An error has occurred while sending an email. Please try again or contact our support team.
mail.action.delete.name: Delete email
mail.action.delete.description: Deletes an email from the inbox
mail.action.delete.input.mail.name: Email
mail.action.delete.input.mail.descriptio: The email from which the entry is to be deleted
mail.action.delete.input.entry.name: Entry ID
mail.action.delete.input.entry.descripti: The ID of the email entry from the inbox that is to be deleted
mail.action.delete.failure.mail.not.foun: An error has occurred while deleting an email. The error occurred because the mail account could not be found. Could it be that you have removed the email?
mail.action.delete.failure.mail.entry.no: An error has occurred while deleting an email. The error has occurred because the email to be deleted could not be found. Is it possible that the email has already been deleted?
mail.action.delete.failure.mail.exceptio: An error has occurred while deleting an email. Please try again or contact our support team.
